title: Merge Two Sorted Lists
statement: Two invigilators each sorted their stack of roll numbers in non-decreasing order. Combine both stacks into one list that is still sorted.
input_format: The first line contains n and m. The second line contains n sorted integers and the third line contains m sorted integers. A list with zero elements has an empty line.
output_format: Print all n + m values in non-decreasing order, separated by spaces.

examples.explanation: Taking the smaller front value each time gives 1 2 3 4 9.

hints: Both lists are already sorted; you do not need a general sort.
Keep one index into each list and repeatedly take the smaller current value.
When one list runs out, copy the rest of the other list.
